bio.text: Helena Foulkes won the Democratic primary for Rhode Island governor on September 9, 2026, defeating incumbent Gov. Dan McKee, and is on the November 3 general-election ballot.
She is a former president of CVS Pharmacy, where she spent a 25-year career after working in investment banking; she has not previously held elected office.
Foulkes graduated from Harvard College in 1986 and has served on the boards of Home Depot, Salesforce and Costco Wholesale; the Brown Daily Herald describes Rhode Island as her home state.
She also ran for the Democratic nomination for governor in 2022, narrowly losing the primary to McKee.

sources.title: Helena Foulkes wins Democratic nomination for R.I. governor
